title: Jobs and plans for the future
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a diákmunkáról, a szüleid munkájáról és a pályaválasztási terveidről kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és indokold a véleményedet.

questions.q: What do your parents do? Do they like their jobs?
Have you ever had a summer job or a part-time job?
followUps: What did you have to do?
What did you spend the money on?

questions.q: What kind of summer jobs can students get in your area?
Would you like to work while you are studying? Why or why not?
What job would you like to do in the future?
followUps: Why does this job interest you?

questions.q: What is more important for you in a job: a good salary or interesting work?
Would you like to work abroad one day? Where?
Do you know anyone who has an unusual job? What do they do?
Are you planning to go to university or to start working after school?

usefulPhrases.en: My mum works as a nurse.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do your parents do? Do they like their jobs?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My mum is a nurse at the hospital in Pécs, and my dad works as an electrician. My mum loves helping people, but she's often tired because she works night shifts.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you ever had a summer job or a part-time job?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, last summer I worked as a waiter in a restaurant at Lake Balaton for six weeks. It was my first real job, so I was a bit nervous at the beginning.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What did you have to do?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I had to take orders, carry plates and clear the tables. It was hard work, especially at weekends, but the tips were good.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What job would you like to do in the future?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd like to be a software developer. I've been interested in computers since primary school, and I'm learning programming online at the moment.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What is more important for you in a job: a good salary or interesting work?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: For me, interesting work is more important. If you do something boring every day, you won't be happy, even if you earn a lot of money.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésre érdemben felel, a véleménykérdésnél pedig világosan állást foglal és meg is indokolja (If you do something boring every day …).
Szókincs: a munka világának pontos kifejezései szerepelnek (works as an electrician, night shifts, take orders, clear the tables, tips, software developer).

Nyelvhelyesség: a múltbeli munkát egyszerű múlt írja le (I worked, I had to), a máig tartó érdeklődést befejezett jelen (I've been interested … since …), az általános igazságot pedig helyes első feltételes mondat (If you do …, you won't be …).
Érdemes megtanulni: „she works night shifts”, „It was hard work, especially at weekends”, „I've been interested in computers since primary school”, „even if you earn a lot of money”.
